title: Investments
description: Where your money is invested, from the latest snapshot of each holding. Buy and sell from a product's page (or the Transfers page); its value only changes when you record a snapshot.
emptyAccounts: No investment accounts yet - add one on the Accounts page.

allocation.emptyValues: No investment values yet - record a snapshot on a product to see the allocation.
allocation.staleFootnote: * Includes a product with a buy or sell newer than its latest snapshot, so this value may be out of date. Record a snapshot on the product to refresh it.

subcategoryChart.emptyValues: No investment values yet - record a snapshot on a product to see the allocation.
subcategoryChart.staleFootnote: * Includes a product with a buy or sell newer than its latest snapshot, so this value may be out of date. Record a snapshot on the product to refresh it.

accountChart.emptyValues: No investment values yet - record a snapshot on a holding to see the allocation by account.
accountChart.staleFootnote: * Includes a holding with a buy or sell newer than its latest snapshot, so this value may be out of date. Record a snapshot on it to refresh it.
